1712	## Acceptance Criteria
1713	
1714	Every criterion is GIVEN / WHEN / THEN, cites the rule that it verifies, and carries a tag. Ids are `AC-HS-n`; rule ids are `HS-n`. The two are **offset** (for example AC-HS-13 verifies HS-11), so a story must cite the **rule id**, never the AC number alone. The criteria were drafted from the rules, reviewed by the qa-lead (95 drafted; 9 tag corrections; 24 rewrites; 29 added), and the seven GDD defects the review found (F-1 to F-7) were fixed in the rule text before this section was closed.
1715	
1716	**Tags.** **(auto)** gdUnit4 headless: a pure `HudMath` function, a layout function or a scripted fixture, in `tests/unit/hud/` or `tests/integration/hud/`. **(auto-windowed)** *(added 2026-10-27, design review)* a gdUnit4 test that needs a rendering device (draw calls, primitives, drawn-pixel colours, pixel-identical frames): the headless CI command cannot run it, so it runs in a separate **render lane** (a windowed job on a machine with a GPU) and **also has a headless oracle**, a *scene-state hash* (the ordered list of visible HUD nodes with atlas region, rectangle, modulate and visibility) that the headless lane asserts on every push, so the regression is caught even when the render lane runs nightly. Tags written `(auto)` in the first draft of a pixel or draw-call criterion are corrected to this one. **(lint)** a static or scene-tree scan of source, data, scenes or atlas names. **(review)** a reviewer reads text or data and records a line in the evidence file. **(manual)** a launched build observed by a person, with a **retained screenshot in `production/qa/evidence/`** (a parse check is not a run; a manual criterion is not closed until its screenshot is on disk). **(manual+auto)** the model is asserted headlessly and the look is proved by a retained screenshot; use it wherever the observable is visual. **(auto, provisional)** written against the HUD's proposed Adapter or Suit read and re-based when the owner answers the ASK. **(spike)** a measured prototype whose result is recorded in Open Questions with PASS or FAIL and a named fallback; a spike does not gate a story. **MVP** = live at MVP; **RESERVED** = specified and built, dormant until Vertical Slice A or B (driven by a stub Filter or stub seat in tests). "THIN fixture" = a compartment with `p_o2` inside the THIN band and an honest suit. **No criterion asserts what a Vertical Slice A lying reading does to its warning mark, in either direction** (CF-HS-19, CF-HS-15).
1717	
1718	**Mode and defaults** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*. Unless a criterion says otherwise, the mark and arbiter criteria run with `reduce_flashing` and `reduced_motion` OFF: the fixture overrides the first-launch default of user ruling D79 so that the mark pulses and the arbiter is in WEIGHTED mode. Criteria that need the strict ceiling name STRICT; AC-HS-38 and AC-HS-110 cover the first-launch default itself.
1719	
1720	**Evidence mapping.** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review: a HUD test-support prerequisite epic.)* **No HUD story can be tested until the test-support epic exists:** the stub Suit, Filter, Interaction, Controller (`confirm_view`, `glyph_view`) and Save/Load, the kernel clock with a scripted `(T, tick_alpha)` pinner, the fixture runner, the scene-state hasher and the pixel-colour scanner; every HUD story depends on it (OQ-HS-68). Logic criteria (formulas, the arbiter, the state machines): `tests/unit/hud/`, BLOCKING. Integration criteria (stub Suit, Filter, Interaction, Save/Load; presenter order): `tests/integration/hud/`, BLOCKING. UI and Visual criteria: retained screenshots in `production/qa/evidence/` for every surface and state listed in "Evidence plan" below, BLOCKING and not waived at `qa.level: minimal`. Config/Data (`hud_tuning` range validation): automated here although the standard makes it ADVISORY.
1721	
1722	### A. Identity, layer and reads (HS-1 to HS-10)
1723	
1724	- **AC-HS-1 (auto, MVP)** GIVEN the kernel registry dump after boot with the HUD loaded WHEN the registrations attributed to the HUD owner are listed THEN the list is exactly one `PRESENTATION` subscriber and zero hooks, state blocks, commands, mutators, RNG streams and `INPUT_SURFACE` subscribers; and a boot with the HUD removed still passes registry validation (the HUD is in no hook's `after:` list). (HS-1)
1725	- **AC-HS-2 (lint, MVP)** GIVEN HUD source, data and scenes WHEN scanned THEN there is no `true_value` call site and no reference to it outside the Debug Overlay allow-list; the HUD calls `perceived(...)` only (Filter AC-PF-51; Debug Overlay P-1). (HS-4)
1726	- **AC-HS-3 (lint, MVP)** GIVEN the HUD source WHEN scanned THEN no code draws a number from `view()`'s four reading fields (`o2_pp_dkpa`, `reserve_pm`, `cell_pm`, `integrity_pm`) (Suit AC-SE-77). (HS-5)
1727	- **AC-HS-4 (lint, MVP)** GIVEN the HUD source WHEN scanned THEN the HUD reads none of `node()`, `edge()`, `abort_cause`, `interaction.state`, `failures()`, Graph state, `lit(ref)`, `peer_id`, Attention, Horror or Sanity state, or any `PERCEPTION_OUT` block (the read table of HS-6 is closed). (HS-6)
1728	- **AC-HS-5 (lint, MVP)** GIVEN the HUD scene tree and data WHEN scanned THEN there is no Overlay control in any HUD state: no HUD node hosts, instantiates or parents a Debug Overlay node, no HUD surface carries a debug toggle, and `hud_debug_snapshot()` is read-only and carries no `k`. (HS-57; Debug Overlay P-1)
1729	- **AC-HS-6 (lint, MVP)** GIVEN the HUD surfaces, strings, glyphs and data WHEN scanned THEN there is no sanity surface (no sanity number, bar, ring, icon, colour or glyph) and no Attention, noise, light, illumination, exposure, `lit_state`, `exposed` or `exposure` indicator, no horror, threat or proximity indicator, under any setting. (HS-10)
1730	- **AC-HS-7 (lint, MVP)** GIVEN the forbidden-surface list (minimap, compass, objective, off-screen arrow, crew locator, room name, ship status, weight or capacity, health bar, damage number, hit flash, vignette, tint, toast, banner, popup, death screen, score, autosave glyph, "repaired" confirmation, a countdown to an event the HUD names (the reserve numeral of HS-17 is a reading, not such a countdown, and is allowed), spinner, Alarm Red text, ring or radial progress, UI cursor in `gameplay`; the one exception, the opt-in `hud_aim_indicator`, may exist only while `aim_indicator` is on, AC-HS-134) WHEN the HUD scene tree, string table and atlas names are scanned THEN none exists. (HS-10)

1743	- **AC-HS-17 (lint, MVP)** GIVEN HUD data and source including the dial-generator script WHEN scanned THEN there is no dkPa band literal for the O2 zone edges; each edge is read by name (`O2_BAND_ANOXIC_PP`, `HYPOXIA_PP`, `O2_BAND_THIN_PP`). (HS-13)

# Design Directory

When authoring or editing files in this directory, follow these standards.

## GDD Files (`design/gdd/`)

The 8 GDD sections, in order:
1. Overview — one-paragraph summary
2. Player Fantasy — intended feeling and experience
3. Detailed Rules — unambiguous mechanics
4. Formulas — all math defined with variables
5. Edge Cases — unusual situations handled
6. Dependencies — other systems listed
7. Tuning Knobs — configurable values identified
8. Acceptance Criteria — testable success conditions

**How many are REQUIRED depends on `modes.workflow`** — all 8 at `full`; 5 at
`standard` (Overview, Detailed Rules, Edge Cases, Dependencies, Acceptance
Criteria, plus Formulas when the system has math); none at `minimal`, where
`design/game-brief.md` is the design record instead of a GDD. Resolve the tier
before flagging a section as missing — see `.claude/docs/workflow-modes.md`.

> **Three other places already encode the tier rule** —
> `.claude/docs/coding-standards.md`, `.claude/rules/design-docs.md` and
> `.claude/hooks/validate-commit.sh`. This file is the copy a session working in
> `design/` reads first, so it must agree with them: demanding all 8 at
> `minimal` warns a jam project about six sections its own configuration says it
> does not need, which trains the user to ignore the warning.

**Section-name alias:** the GDD template and `/design-system` author section 3
as `## Detailed Design`; the standard calls it **Detailed Rules**. Same required
section — accept either heading, never rewrite one into the other.

**File naming:** `[system-slug].md` (e.g. `movement-system.md`, `combat-system.md`)

**Systems index:** `design/gdd/systems-index.md` — update when adding a new GDD.

**Design order:** Foundation → Core → Feature → Presentation → Polish

**Validation:** Run `/design-review [path]` after authoring any GDD.
Run `/review-all-gdds` after completing a set of related GDDs.

## Quick Specs (`design/quick-specs/`)

Lightweight specs for tuning changes, minor mechanics, or balance adjustments.
Use `/quick-design` to author.

## UX Specs (`design/ux/`)

- Per-screen specs: `design/ux/[screen-name].md`
- HUD design: `design/ux/hud.md`
- Interaction pattern library: `design/ux/interaction-patterns.md`
- Accessibility requirements: `design/accessibility-requirements.md`

Use `/ux-design` to author. Validate with `/ux-review` before passing to `/team-ui`.

> **Accessibility requirements sit OUTSIDE `design/ux/` on purpose.** They are a
> project-wide standard the per-screen specs consult, not a spec for one screen.
> `.claude/docs/workflow-catalog.yaml`, the Pre-Production, Production and Polish
> gates, and `/architecture-review` all check `design/accessibility-requirements.md`
> at that exact path. Do not "tidy" it under `design/ux/` — every one of those
> checks would stop matching, and the Technical Setup → Pre-Production gate would
> become unpassable. `/ux-design` states the same rule at its `accessibility` mode.

</system-reminder>

### G. The prompt plate and the channel bar (HS-37 to HS-45; D.16, D.18, D.19)

- **AC-HS-54 (auto, MVP)** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* GIVEN a focus that is stable for 12 then 13 ticks WHEN the plate is evaluated THEN it does not show at 12 and shows at 13 provided `since_last_show >= 20`; GIVEN `prompt_state` HIDDEN or `focus_ref` changed THEN the plate hides in the same render frame; GIVEN a **replay** of focus changing every 12 ticks for 10 s THEN **no plate is drawn on any render frame** (not for 50 ms), and GIVEN a replay of 11-tick churn THEN likewise none; no more than three plates start in any rolling second (Interaction AC-IA-72); GIVEN an accepted press on a focus stable for 5 ticks THEN the plate shows on the press frame. (D.18, HS-37)
- **AC-HS-55 (auto, MVP)** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review: the fixture is stated)* **Fixture (the pure function in STRICT mode with the mark's edges injected to exercise the arithmetic; (d) is WEIGHTED):** a stub kernel at `TICK_RATE` 60 with `BEACON_SWEEP_TICKS` 128 and `u` = 1; the honest numerals are static in (a) (no grid event) and falling at every boundary in (b); the show-start requests are post-debounce (the debounce is AC-HS-54's subject) and **only show-starts are injected, with no hide events, so no pair completes and no orphan hide is counted** (the hide cases are AC-HS-142) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*; the mark is active from tick 0 with its leading edges at multiples of 128; the arbiter clock is the committed tick. (a) GIVEN show-start requests every 10 ticks from tick 0, filtered first by D.18 (`PROMPT_MIN_CYCLE_TICKS` 20), with a mark edge scheduled at tick 128 WHEN `flash_admit` runs THEN the admitted show-starts are at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 and 140, and in every run no half-open 1000 ms window contains more than 3 HUD luminance events. (b) GIVEN numerals falling at every boundary at `HONEST_TICK_MS` 500 and one mark WHEN run for 60 s THEN the long-run admitted prompt show-starts are at most 0.53 per second (about one per 1.9 s, leading-edge unit) and the maximum luminance events in any window is 3. (c) Positional events are not counted: a 40-px bar filling in one second adds 0 events. (d) *(WEIGHTED mode, user ruling D91 (iv))* GIVEN the same show-start requests at 1080p `H` 3 (ENABLED plate, weight 34) with the mark edge at tick 128 WHEN `flash_admit` runs THEN the requests filtered by D.18 are all admitted, at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120 and 140; those at 0, 20, 60, 80, 120 and 140 are exempt and those at 40 and 100 are counted (their cumulative weight reached 102); in no window do the counted events plus the mark edge exceed 3; GIVEN the same requests at 720p `H` 3 with a NEEDS_TOOL plate (weight 115) THEN none is exempt and the result equals (a). (D.2, HS-45) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*
- **AC-HS-127 (auto + manual, MVP)** GIVEN the reference breach fixture (numeral falling on every `HONEST_TICK_MS` boundary, the mark pulsing at `BEACON_SWEEP_TICKS` 128, a valve entering focus and staying stable) WHEN `flash_admit` runs over 20 s of simulated ticks THEN the prompt show-start (no press) is admitted at most `PROMPT_SHOW_DEBOUNCE_TICKS + HONEST_GRID_TICKS` ticks after focus is stable when at most one other counted event is in the window (13 + 30 = 43 at the defaults, 717 ms; typically the debounce alone, 13 ticks, 217 ms, when only the two grid events are in the window; AC-HS-144 asserts both) and at most 13 + `MAX_DEFER_TICKS` 60 = 73 ticks in any case, and 0 frames after an accepted press on an ENABLED or NEEDS_TOOL subject *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*, the prompt is admitted ahead of the grid boundary that would breach `FLASH_MAX_PER_S` (that boundary is skipped and the next shows the then-latest value), no window of `TICK_RATE` ticks holds more than `FLASH_MAX_PER_S` leading-edge events, and the mark edge is never delayed; WHEN the breach fixture is played by a tester THEN the tester records, for each valve prompt, whether it was perceived as late (the playtest hook OQ-HS-59). **Mode** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*: the figures above are STRICT mode (the first-launch default, the mark's edges injected into the pure function); in WEIGHTED mode the same fixture shows the plate at `PROMPT_SHOW_DEBOUNCE_TICKS` (13 ticks, 217 ms) at 1080p `H` 3 (ENABLED weight 34) and skips no numeral boundary. (HS-45, HS-47, D.2, Game Feel)
- **AC-HS-144 (auto, MVP)** *(Added 2026-10-27 — re-review; the first-launch STRICT breach, end to end)* GIVEN a fresh `HudSettings` (STRICT, the mark **solid**, no injected edges, **no plate drawn or hidden in the 60 ticks before the valve becomes stable**, so no previous plate's orphan hide is in the window), the breach fixture (`breath_src` ROOM to RESERVE at tick 380, the honest numerals falling at every boundary) and a valve entering focus stable at tick 100 (before the swap) and again at tick 400 (inside the swap's window) WHEN `flash_admit` runs THEN (a) the **typical** latency, valve stable at tick 100 with only the two grid events in the window, is **13 ticks** (the plate is drawn at tick 113); (b) the **worst-case** latency, valve stable at tick 400 with the swap event and the grid events in the window, is **at most 43 ticks** and the numeral's boundary is skipped once and shows the then-latest value on the next, so the numeral's lag never exceeds 1000 ms; (c) with a second hue cut added the plate is drawn at most 73 ticks after stable focus and `HUD_FLASH_OVERRUN` increments only if it was force-admitted at the bound; (d) a press at tick 405 (accepted, ENABLED) draws the plate and the ACK on tick 405 itself. (HS-45, HS-47, Game Feel step 3; the figures replace "717 ms is the first-launch latency")
- **AC-HS-135 (auto, MVP)** *(Added 2026-10-27 — user rulings, D91 (iv))* GIVEN the pure functions `flash_weight_pm` and `exempt` WHEN evaluated THEN a six-cell numeral change (210 px) weighs 9 at 1080p `H` 3 (canvas 640 x 360), 19 on the Deck (`keep`, 426 x 240, the same as 720p `H` 3) and 33 at 1080p `H` 6; the ENABLED plate (864 px) weighs 34, 60, 94 and 135 at 1080p `H` 3, 4, 5 and 6 and 77 on the Deck and at 720p; the NEEDS_TOOL plate (1,296 px) weighs 51, 90 and 141 at 1080p `H` 3, 4 and 5 and 115 on the Deck and at 720p *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review: one Deck picture mode)*; a two-line plate (2,160 px) weighs 85 at 1080p `H` 3 and 150 at `H` 4; GIVEN STRICT mode (`reduce_flashing` on) THEN no event is exempt and every HS-47 event counts; GIVEN WEIGHTED mode THEN only the DIGIT_SWAP and PROMPT_SHOW_START classes can be exempt, an Alarm Red mark edge is never exempt, and the cumulative guard returns an event to `admit` when its weight plus `X(t)` reaches `FLASH_AREA_EXEMPT_PM`; GIVEN `FLASH_AREA_EXEMPT_PM` 101 THEN data validation fails. (D.2, HS-47)
- **AC-HS-56 (auto, MVP)** GIVEN a chest point at HUD (x, y) and anchors A1 on top of the chest point (no AD-5 placement clears the 16-px keep-out), A2 two px outside the picture edge, and A3 inside the strip rectangle WHEN drawn THEN A1, A2 and A3 all draw no plate (never clamped); `UI_PLACEMENT_WITHHELD` increments for A1 and A3 and not for A2 (off screen is not a withheld placement); no plate rectangle, including the `give_up` plate *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)* and the self plate (AC-HS-150) *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix; delegated ruling G6, GAP)*, ever overlaps the chest keep-out or the strip, panel or rail rectangles. (HS-39, EC-HS-2, EC-HS-7, EC-HS-8)
- **AC-HS-107 (auto, MVP)** GIVEN a prompt whose AD-5 placements all fail the keep-out or the 4-px margin THEN no plate is drawn and `UI_PLACEMENT_WITHHELD` increments by exactly 1; GIVEN a placement that needs the fallback THEN the plate sits `PROMPT_ANCHOR_OFFSET_WORLD_PX` 28 world px from the anchor at every zoom step `k` (28 x `k` screen px), never a fixed HUD-px distance. (HS-39, EC-HS-7)
- **AC-HS-57 (auto, MVP)** GIVEN the plate is projected at `k` 1, 3 and `k_auto + 2` with `H` fixed WHEN re-projected from the unjolted pose THEN the plate size in HUD px is unchanged and its position is `floor(ax) - (w div 2)` with `ax` from `world_to_hud(anchor_o)` (D.9); and with a non-zero camera jolt offset the plate position is unchanged (jolt is never applied). (HS-37, D.9)
- **AC-HS-58 (manual, MVP)** GIVEN a launched build facing a lit weld offer WHEN captured THEN the plate shows one keycap and the verb text ("Weld"), a 4 x 3 anchor tab on the edge nearest the anchor, no condition or target text; and the NEEDS_TOOL variant is the taller notched plate with the 16 x 16 tool glyph, not red, not flashing; screenshots retained. (HS-37, HS-38)
- **AC-HS-59 (auto, MVP)** GIVEN `channel_view.length_class` SHORT, MEDIUM and LONG WHEN the bar is laid out THEN the interior lengths are 16, 24 and 40 HUD px, ordered S < M < L, on the plate's long edge facing away from the anchor, with a Tungsten fill and a Paper White needle-mark 2 wide by 8 tall; and no ring or radial exists. (HS-40, D.19)
- **AC-HS-60 (auto, MVP)** GIVEN SHORT (`L` 16, 48-tick hold at the default; an adjusted hold, D80, changes only the ticks per pixel, since the fill follows `hold_pm`) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* THEN `progress_pm` 500 gives 8, 1000 gives 16, 62 gives 0 and 63 gives 1; GIVEN MEDIUM (`L` 24, 90-tick cap) THEN `progress_pm` 333 gives 7 and 1000 gives 24; GIVEN LONG (`L` 40, 240-tick cut) THEN 0, 250, 500 and 1000 give 0, 10, 20 and 40; and the HUD draws whichever `length_class` it is given and never recomputes it (a channel at exactly `BAR_LONG_FROM_TICKS` 240 is LONG and at 239 is MEDIUM, Interaction's call). (D.19)
- **AC-HS-61 (auto, MVP)** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* GIVEN a press WHEN accepted (`confirm_view.pressed_action`) THEN the keycap drops 1 art px and the track appears at fill 0 on the same render frame (ACK), **and a plate that was still inside the debounce, the minimum cycle or an arbiter wait is force-admitted on that frame** (HS-37; the arbiter counts it as non-deferrable); GIVEN no result within `PREPLAY_MAX_TICKS` THEN the pre-play is withdrawn; GIVEN a result event of kind REJECTED THEN the bar is withdrawn within one render frame and the restored keycap is held Graphite-lit for `BAR_REJECT_HOLD_TICKS` with at most one reject presentation per seat per `PROMPT_MIN_CYCLE_TICKS`, with no shake, flash, red or text, identical for every reason, and a reject with no plate shown draws nothing. (HS-41)
- **AC-HS-62 (auto, MVP)** GIVEN `channel_view` transitions across a render frame spanning several ticks WHEN cues are edge-detected from `transition_seq` and `result_seq` THEN a terminal transition (ABORT, DONE, OUTCOME) is never skipped and intermediate loops are skipped; only the local seat's channel is drawn. (HS-41)
- **AC-HS-63 (manual+auto, MVP)** GIVEN each state ABORT, DONE and OUTCOME WHEN drawn THEN (auto) ABORT with `ended_by` `WORLD` snaps the fill empty with a 2 x 2 Ground break-notch for `BAR_HOLD_DONE_TICKS` 12, the same frame set for every world cause, and ABORT with `ended_by` `PLAYER_CANCEL` drains the fill over `BAR_DRAIN_MS` 400 with no notch (AC-HS-65); the HUD never reads `abort_cause` *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*; DONE holds full 12 ticks then cuts with no checkmark, flash or "repaired" text; OUTCOME fills exactly as DONE then removes the bar and steps the plate border to Graphite mid for 12 ticks with no text; (manual) screenshots of each are retained. (HS-41)
- **AC-HS-64 (auto, MVP)** GIVEN the subject becomes unlit mid-channel WHEN `prompt_state` goes HIDDEN THEN the plate hides the same render frame and the bar stays until the simulation's abort (at most 5 dark ticks). (HS-40, EC-HS-32)
- **AC-HS-65 (auto, MVP once `confirm_view` lands; written against the agreed shape)** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* GIVEN `confirm_view.hold_pm` falling after a release THEN the drawn fill is `(hold_pm * L) div 1000` with no HUD-side drain (the Controller drains `b`), a SHORT bar from full at 0.2 s leaves 8 px and is empty at 0.4 s, and reduced motion snaps to 0 in one frame. content.thinking:
I'm narrowing this down to about nine rows, making sure the HUD test seam connects to Suit, Filter, Interaction, Controller, Save/Load, and the kernel clock through injectable stub interfaces, with scripted tick inputs and an exposed scene-state hash, tying it back to the relevant acceptance criteria anchors.

Then I move to the settle propagator, specifying it as a closed-form critically damped semigroup that stays frame-rate independent, clamps steps safely, and avoids NaN while allowing continuous retargeting. I continue through mark/rung cross-system behavior where Suit publishes per-axis states and derives mark_active without thresholds, then the perceived-record schema contract where Filter owns the lie schedule and HUD can't reschedule it, followed by band/zone constants that must be read by name from their owners rather than hardcoded, with lint failures on bad data. I'm now starting the Interaction/Controller sequence-edge contract row.

Next I cover camera projection rules distinguishing re-projection from relayout, the HudLayout display matrix as a pure function with a closed table of configs and safe margins, and I'm moving into localization requirements around tr() keys, plate wrapping, and pseudo-locale expansion.

Then I move through presentation state lifecycle (HUD unmounted until first tick, no pulls during LOADING/DEAD), input mode rules for cursor and focus during gameplay, shared theme requirements across Controls, and finally note that local-seat-only reading and palette contrast are already covered elsewhere so I'm skipping those as duplicates.

Now I'm tallying up the acceptance criteria counts across each category -- roughly 12 for group A, 12 for B, 11 for C, 9 for D, 7 each for E and F, plus a handful more for additions and strip/panel items -- to get a sense of total coverage.

That gives roughly 149, close enough to settle on that count.
